reader.requirement: At --std 85, after a USE procedure ends, control returns to the next executable statement after the failing I-O statement when the status is not critical (first digit not 3 or 4), inside IF, inline PERFORM and mid-sentence too, without running the statement's NOT INVALID KEY phrase; after a critical status the action is the implementor's (WiseOwl continues, documented in DOC-A.1-218).

edition-consulted.switches: refuses USE Format 3/4 (EC model, COBOL0877) and Format 1 without AFTER/PROCEDURE below 2002
DialectLevel >= 2002 adds the SORT GR17 exit filter to an EC-free __RunUse; 1985 takes the bare try/finally invoker (same dispatch, same return to the caller)

reader.edition-search: UseTierEmitter.EmitScopeTiers (file-name tier then open-mode tier), DispatchEmitter.EmitUseMachinery (__IoCheck), ProgramEmitter.EmitRunGlobalUse/ChainHasGlobalUse consult no edition: grep of Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel|DialectBehavior|IsAtLeast over DispatchEmitter.cs, UseTierEmitter.cs, EcEmitter.cs, ProgramEmitter.cs, SequentialIoEmitter.cs, KeyedIoEmitter.cs, IoStatusClass.cs, ProcedureTableBuilder.cs; UseTierEmitter's remarks record the tiers as edition-invariant by determination (kb/Work PB344). reader.notes: The 1985 __RunUse is the plain try/finally invoker and the call site falls through to the next statement. Continuing after a critical status is the documented implementor choice (DOC-A.1-218); an uncovered fatal status with neither FILE STATUS nor USE terminates (DOC-A.1-103), which a USE that ran never reaches.

refuter.evidence: r6_flow.cob (r6_flow-001): a two-paragraph USE section followed by another declarative section ran both paragraphs and never fell into the next section; control returned to the next executable statement after the failing statement as the last statement of a PERFORMed paragraph (AFTER-PERFORM 23), inside an ELSE arm (IN-ELSE 23, then AFTER-IF), inside another READ's NOT INVALID KEY (IN-NOT-INVALID 23), inside an EVALUATE WHEN (IN-WHEN 23), and at a paragraph's end falling through to the next paragraph (P-4 22). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IX.4.8.4 GR6  (4.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6' for 'returns control to the next executable statement following the input-output statement'. r1_prec.cob also showed the return to each contained program's next statement after a container's GLOBAL declarative (B/C/D/E RESUMED lines).
